cues.en: Hello, welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: I hope you're as excited as I am because, today, we'll find out how gradient boosting works.
cues.zh: 希望你和我一樣期待，今天看看梯度提升如何運作。

cues.en: All right, we're going to work with a sample mock dataset, which is completely made up.
cues.zh: 使用一份完全虛構的範例資料集。

cues.en: It's over here, but it does resemble something interesting in the real world.
cues.zh: 就在這裡，但它類似真實世界有趣的現象。

cues.en: It is based on the Dunning-Kruger effect.
cues.zh: 根據達克效應，也就是 Dunning-Kruger effect。

cues.en: And in order to understand that a bit better, we're going to look at...
cues.zh: 為了更理解，先看看……

cues.en: We're gonna search for Dunning-Kruger effect over here, and then you'll see lots of these charts, which are like U-shaped.
cues.zh: 搜尋 Dunning-Kruger effect，會看到很多這種 U 形圖。

cues.en: And typically, what this explains is a psychological effect.
cues.zh: 通常用來解釋一種心理現象。

cues.en: When somebody is learning something new, let's say a person is learning chess for the first time.
cues.zh: 某人學新東西，例如第一次學西洋棋。

cues.en: At the beginning, their level of confidence will be very high.
cues.zh: 一開始自信很高。

cues.en: So, this is their confidence, and this is their actual competence in whatever they're learning.
cues.zh: 這是自信，這是所學事情的實際能力。

cues.en: It could be chess, it could be music, it could be a language, it could be anything.
cues.zh: 可能是西洋棋、音樂、語言，任何東西。

cues.en: So at the beginning, they're very confident.
cues.zh: 一開始非常有自信。

cues.en: As their level of actual competence grows, their confidence drops because they realize more and more things that they don't know.
cues.zh: 實際能力增加後，自信下降，因為發現越來越多自己不知道的事。

cues.en: And then, eventually, it starts to grow again once they become more and more expert at whatever they're learning.
cues.zh: 最後越來越專精時，自信又開始上升。

cues.en: So that's an interesting psychological phenomenon that we have here, and so just imagine that this dataset represents
cues.zh: 這是有趣的心理現象。假設這份資料集代表

cues.en: like a study that psychologists did, and it has lots of people that were surveyed.
cues.zh: 心理學家的研究，調查了很多人。

cues.en: This is their actual level of competence in a certain skill and this is their perceived, self-perceived level of confidence.
cues.zh: 這是特定技能的實際能力，這是自覺的自信程度。

cues.en: And so, it kind of resembles that curve.
cues.zh: 所以看起來像那條曲線。

cues.en: So, now, let's see how we can model it with gradient boosting.
cues.zh: 看看如何用梯度提升建模。

cues.en: So, as we discussed, gradient boosting works in the following way.
cues.zh: 如前所述，梯度提升這樣運作。

cues.en: There's original dataset, then we create the first model.
cues.zh: 有原始資料，再建立第一個模型。

cues.en: Then, from that, we look at the residuals or the errors, then we model that, then we look at the residuals or errors, we model that, and so on, and so on, and so on.
cues.zh: 看殘差、誤差，對它建模，再看殘差、再建模，持續下去。

cues.en: And then the final model, the sum of all model is the sum of all those models.
cues.zh: 最後模型是所有模型的總和。

cues.en: So, let's proceed to that.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: We're gonna start with this first model, and in fact, we'll have a little tracker over here at the top, which will show us which model we're talking about on which slide.
cues.zh: 先從第一個模型，頂端有小進度標記，顯示目前投影片在談哪個模型。

cues.en: So, in this first case, we've got our original data.
cues.zh: 首先是原始資料。

cues.en: We're gonna apply the first model.
cues.zh: 套用第一個模型。

cues.en: And typically, the first model is very simple.
cues.zh: 通常第一個很簡單。

cues.en: It's just like an average.
cues.zh: 只是平均值。

cues.en: We just take the average of all the y-values and we get some numbers, for example, 0.54.
cues.zh: 取所有 y 值平均，例如 0.54。

cues.en: And that is our model, that's all of the model.
cues.zh: 這就是整個模型。

cues.en: It's a very simple model that just predicts 0.54 for any data point, regardless of where it is on the x-axis.
cues.zh: 很簡單，不管 X 軸在哪，任何資料點都預測 0.54。

cues.en: And what we're going to do now is we're going to find out the errors, the residuals.
cues.zh: 現在找出誤差，也就是殘差。

cues.en: Well, their errors are gonna look like this.
cues.zh: 誤差長這樣。

cues.en: And you can see here the x-axis is higher, meaning the y-axis 0 is here.
cues.zh: 可以看到 X 軸更高，也就是 Y 的 0 在這裡。

cues.en: So basically, yeah, so each one of these values is the associated value on this curve minus 0.54, and that's how we get these residuals.
cues.zh: 每個值就是曲線對應值減 0.54，得到殘差。

cues.en: Now, we take the residuals and we put them on the left.
cues.zh: 把殘差放到左邊。

cues.en: And as you can see, the tracker has moved.
cues.zh: 可以看到進度標記移動了。

cues.en: So, we are building Model Number 2, and we're going to apply it to these residuals.
cues.zh: 現在建立第二個模型，套用到殘差。

cues.en: And as for Model Number 2, we are going to just use a simple, very simple decision tree.
cues.zh: 第二個使用非常簡單的決策樹。

cues.en: Now, we'll talk more about why these red lines are where they are and not somewhere else, how these two positions were chosen.
cues.zh: 為什麼紅線在這裡，而不是別處，這兩個位置怎麼選，

cues.en: We'll talk about that in a separate tutorial.
cues.zh: 另一堂會談。

cues.en: But let's talk about conceptually what happens.
cues.zh: 先看概念上發生什麼。

cues.en: So, once we apply decision tree, it is applied to this dataset.
cues.zh: 套用決策樹到這份資料集。

cues.en: The dataset, all residuals now.
cues.zh: 現在資料集全部是殘差。

cues.en: And now, for the residuals, it predicts value.
cues.zh: 它會對殘差預測值。

cues.en: So for this first leaf, it'll predict 0.1.
cues.zh: 第一個葉節點預測 0.1。

cues.en: For the second leaf, minus 0.2, which is the average again.
cues.zh: 第二個 -0.2，同樣是平均。

cues.en: And for the third leaf, 0.2 again.
cues.zh: 第三個又是 0.2。

cues.en: Well, not again, 0.2 because that's the average.
cues.zh: 不是「又」，就是 0.2，因為這是平均。

cues.en: And so now, we can calculate the residuals for each leaf.
cues.zh: 現在可計算各葉節點殘差。

cues.en: So for the first leaf, we subtract 0.1 from all the values.
cues.zh: 第一個，全部值減 0.1。

cues.en: We get this.
cues.zh: 得到這樣。

cues.en: For the second leaf, we subtract minus 0.2, so we get these residuals.
cues.zh: 第二個減 -0.2，得到這些殘差。

cues.en: And for the third leaf, we get these residuals.
cues.zh: 第三個得到這些殘差。

cues.en: So you can see that by predicting, now the residuals are even smaller.
cues.zh: 可以看到，預測後的殘差更小。

cues.en: So these used to be the residuals, now they're all getting closer to that 0, so the error is becoming smaller as we add more and more models.
cues.zh: 原本殘差在這裡，現在更接近 0，加入更多模型，誤差越小。

cues.en: We're not gonna stop here, we're going to continue, we're gonna move on to Model 3.
cues.zh: 不停在這裡，繼續第三個模型。

cues.en: So, these are the residuals that we have, so here they are, we move them to the left.
cues.zh: 這是現有殘差，移到左邊。

cues.en: And again, we're going to apply another decision tree.
cues.zh: 再次套用另一棵決策樹。

cues.en: Again, we're gonna use a very simple decision tree with just three leaves.
cues.zh: 同樣簡單，只有三個葉節點。

cues.en: It'll be applied something like this.
cues.zh: 大約像這樣。

cues.en: So the average here is 0.12, minus 0.04, and 0.2.
We subtract those averages to get the residuals, and this is what it will look like.
cues.zh: 減去平均，得到殘差，像這樣。

cues.en: So, there are our residuals.
cues.zh: 這就是殘差。

cues.en: Again, it's getting even better.
cues.zh: 再次更好了。

cues.en: Every time we add another model, it gets even better.
cues.zh: 每次加入模型，都更好。

cues.en: So, now, we move on to Model Number 4.
cues.zh: 進第四個模型。

cues.en: There are our residuals that we have.
cues.zh: 這是現在的殘差。

cues.en: We're going to use a bit more complex decision tree this time.
cues.zh: 這次用更複雜一點的樹。

cues.en: This one will have four leaves, and it'll be split like this.
cues.zh: 四個葉節點，這樣分割。

cues.en: So, the average here is 0.
cues.zh: 這裡平均 0。

cues.en: The average here is minus 0.16; here, 0.13; and here, minus 0.01.
So, now, we're going to calculate the new residuals.
cues.zh: 計算新殘差。

cues.en: These ones would've not changed, these ones moved over here, these ones moved down a little bit, and these ones almost didn't change.
cues.zh: 這些不變、這些移到這裡、這些稍微下移、這些幾乎不變。

cues.en: So, there we go, now we have residuals Level 4, and so on, and so on, and so on.
cues.zh: 得到第四階段殘差，繼續下去。

cues.en: We could keep doing that, typically maybe 100, you'd have 100 models, one off to the other doing this and improving.
cues.zh: 可以一直做，通常也許有 100 個模型，一個接一個改善。

cues.en: And of course, our dataset is very small, and the larger dataset should be more sophisticated.
cues.zh: 當然這份資料很小，大型資料集會更複雜。

cues.en: And so, if we sum this up, this was our first model.
cues.zh: 整理一下，這是第一個模型。

cues.en: This was original dataset and the first model that we applied, the simple average, and basically it's not even a decision tree, it's just one number.
cues.zh: 原始資料套用第一個模型，就是平均值，甚至不是決策樹，只是一個數字。

cues.en: Then, after that, we had the residuals, and this was Model Number 2.
cues.zh: 之後有殘差，這是第二個模型。

cues.en: So, we applied Model Number 2 to the residuals of Model Number 1, and we got this decision tree.
cues.zh: 將第二個模型套用到第一個模型殘差，得到這棵樹。

cues.en: So, these numbers are, you know, like I put it in for argument's sake, the 71%, 26%, that's roughly where those red lines are.
cues.zh: 這些 71%、26% 數字只是說明，大致對應紅線位置。

cues.en: Then, Model Number 3 was applied to the residuals of Model Number 2, so you can see the residuals of Model Number 2 over here.
cues.zh: 第三個模型套用到第二個模型殘差，這裡看得到第二個殘差。

cues.en: And the Model Number 3 that's applied is the red and the gray lines, and that resulted in this decision tree.
cues.zh: 第三個模型是紅色與灰色線，得到這棵樹。

cues.en: Well, this is the same as this.
cues.zh: 這和這個相同。

cues.en: This is basically the model and this is what looks like visually when it's applied to the dataset of residuals that we have.
cues.zh: 這是模型，這是在殘差資料集上套用後的視覺樣貌。

cues.en: And finally, Model Number 4 was applied to residuals of Model Number 3, and that's what it looks like.
cues.zh: 最後第四個模型套用第三個模型殘差，像這樣。

cues.en: And so, they go, "That's what the process of building this model looks like."
cues.zh: 這就是建立模型的過程。

cues.en: Of course, in a realistic scenario, this is a very simplified scenario in a realistic hands-on study or situation.
cues.zh: 當然這是非常簡化的情境，真實實作或案例，

cues.en: As you will see in the practical tutorials, the trees are much deeper.
cues.zh: 如你會在實作看到，樹深得多。

cues.en: They have many more levels, many more leaves, and the number of trees is much higher, not just four.
cues.zh: 層數、葉節點更多，樹也不只四棵。

cues.en: You can go up to 100 and 1,000, if you like.
It's a hyperparameter tuning question.
cues.zh: 這是超參數調校問題。

cues.en: But in a nutshell, this is how gradient boosting works.
cues.zh: 簡單來說，就是梯度提升的運作。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
